annotations.title: What to plant in Dubai this month

tools.description: What to sow and plant in Dubai in a given month or season, plus what is flowering, fruiting or ready to harvest, the month's verdict, tips, watch-outs and the climate. Defaults to the current month in Dubai. Also returns that month's indoor-plants block (what to buy, pot up and care for indoors) unless you filter to another group. Start here for any 'what should I plant now / in October / in summer' question.

group.description: Only this kind of plant: vegetables-herbs, flowers, trees-palms, shrubs-climbers, lawn-grasses, indoor (houseplants: the good months to buy and pot up) or water. Omit it to get everything plus the month's indoor block; any group other than indoor leaves the indoor block out.

limit.description: Most plants to list per section, 1–50 (default 20). Long lists are sampled across groups; filter by group to see more.

month.description: Month to plan for: 1–12 or a name like "october". Omit for the current month in Dubai. Not with season.

season.description: A whole season instead of one month: winter (Dec–Feb), spring (Mar–May), summer (Jun–Sep) or autumn (Oct–Nov). Not with month.

tools.name: what_to_plant
tools.title: What to plant in Dubai this month

tools.description: Search and filter the library of plants rated for Dubai's heat, salt, drought and shade: by name (English, botanical, Arabic or a local name such as Hindi or Tagalog), category, sun, water need, minimum tolerance ratings, use, garden style or planting month. For houseplants and questions like "low light, pet friendly plants for a Dubai apartment", filter by light (low, medium, bright-indirect, direct-sun), petSafe, room and size: those four filters return only plants with an indoor profile (light, tolerance of dry air and air conditioning, pet safety, size, rooms). Returns short profiles with links; call get_plant for the full one.

category.description: Only these plant categories (any of them): tree, palm, shrub, climber, groundcover, flower, grass, succulent, herb, edible, indoor, fruit-tree, vegetable, ornamental-grass, aquatic.

group.description: Only this group: vegetables-herbs, flowers, trees-palms, shrubs-climbers, lawn-grasses, indoor or water.

light.description: Houseplants that grow well in this indoor light: low (a dim room or corner), medium (a bright room, no direct sun), bright-indirect (by a window, out of direct sun) or direct-sun (a sunny window). Using light, petSafe, room or size limits results to plants with an indoor profile.

minHeat.description: Minimum heat tolerance in Dubai, 1–5 (5 = best).

minShade.description: Minimum shade tolerance, 1–5 (5 = best); use for shady spots.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for paging; use the nextOffset from the previous page.

petSafe.description: true keeps only houseplants that are non-toxic to cats and dogs (ASPCA list); false means pets do not matter. Using light, petSafe, room or size limits results to plants with an indoor profile.

plantingMonth.description: Only plants with a sowing or planting window in this month (1–12 or a name). For houseplants this is the good months to buy and pot up.

query.description: Words to look for in names (English, botanical, Arabic, and local names such as Hindi or Tagalog, in their own script or Latin letters) and descriptions, e.g. "date palm", "غاف", "gulmohar", "salt tolerant hedge".

room.description: Houseplants that suit this room: living-room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, home-office, majlis, hallway or balcony. Using light, petSafe, room or size limits results to plants with an indoor profile.

size.description: The houseplant's usual indoor size: tabletop (on a table or shelf), medium (a medium pot on a sideboard or the floor) or floor (floor-standing). Using light, petSafe, room or size limits results to plants with an indoor profile.

style.description: Garden style it suits: tropical, manicured, luxury or desert-modern.

sun.description: The plant's light need, exact match: full-sun, sun-part-shade, part-shade or shade.

use.description: What the plant is for: shade-tree, specimen, hedge, screen, windbreak, groundcover, lawn, container, climber, pool-side, fragrance, edible, bedding, indoor or native-habitat.

water.description: Highest water need you accept: "low" keeps very-low and low.

tools.name: search_plants
tools.title: Search the Dubai plant library

tools.description: Everything about one plant in Dubai: ratings, size, sun and water, seasonal calendar, watering in summer and winter, soil, feeding, pruning, pests, common mistakes, varieties, design use, FAQ, photos with credits and sources. Houseplants also get an "Indoors in Dubai" profile: light, tolerance of dry air and air conditioning, pet safety, size, suitable rooms and how easy the plant is to find. Accepts a slug or any name the plant goes by (common, trade, botanical including older names, Arabic, or a local name in its own script or Latin letters); the result lists them all under "Also known as".

plant.description: The plant: its slug ("ghaf") or any name it goes by: common, trade, botanical (including older names such as "Sansevieria trifasciata"), Arabic, or a local name in its own script or Latin letters ("Gulmohar", "गुलमोहर"). Typos are tolerated.

tools.title: Full plant profile

tools.description: Sow, plant, flower, harvest, prune and feed months for a set of plants (by slug, category or group), as a 12-month grid. Use it to compare timings across several plants.

category.description: All plants of one category (shows the first 60).

group.description: All plants of one group (shows the first 60).

slugs.description: Up to 30 plants, by slug or name. Omit slugs, category and group for the kitchen-garden vegetables and herbs.

month.description: Only guides for this time of year (1–12 or a name).

tools.title: Read a guide

tools.description: How to grow vegetables, herbs and fruit at home in Dubai: the sowing and harvest calendar, raised beds vs pots vs a fruit-tree corner, a step-by-step bed build, what to do in summer, common mistakes and FAQ.

annotations.title: Indoor plants in Dubai: the guide

tools.description: The starting point for anything about houseplants and indoor plants in Dubai: choosing by light (low, medium, bright indirect, direct sun), by room and for pets; what air conditioning, tinted glass and dry air change; where to buy and what it costs; how care changes through the year; common problems; and our indoor styles, with every plant linked. Ask for one section (light, rooms, pets, dubai, year, buying, problems, styles, faq) or all of it, and add a month for what to buy and do that month. Then shortlist with search_plants (light, petSafe, room, size) and read one plant with get_plant.

month.description: Also return what to buy and do indoors in this month: 1–12 or a name such as "october". Leave it out for the guide alone.

section.description: Which part of the guide: light (by light level), rooms, pets (pet-safe plants), dubai (air conditioning, glass, dry air), year (care through the year), buying (where to buy), problems, styles (the indoor styles) or faq. all (default) returns everything.

Take a slug from get_indoor_plant_guide (section styles); a wrong slug returns the valid ones and the closest.

slug.description: An indoor style slug or name from get_indoor_plant_guide (section styles), e.g. "japandi-calm".

complexity.description: How demanding the garden is: simple, moderate or complex (mature, dense or intricate planting).

lawn.description: Lawn type: none, natural or artificial.

pool.description: Pool size: none, small (to 25 m² of water), medium (to 50 m²) or large (over 50 m²).

trees.description: Number of trees and palms: "0-5", "6-15" or "16+".
